d.ko: Summer stretches on endlessly. Beneath the vast blue sky. Beneath the air in which she awaits— AIR, the second game released by visual novel studio Key, is now available on Steam! Now featuring the side story novel, "First Sky Chapter" and full voice support!

rv.t: 근본 게임답게 진짜 개슬프다 스토리도 진짜 좋고 후유증도 심함 한줄평: 키에루히코키구모 ㅠㅠ
